mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in a month signals aggressive Fed easing, lowering real rates and boosting equity discount rates, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the prior month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor market strength) coinciding with UNRATE below 5% for two consecutive months predicts stronger wage growth and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE < 5% for two consecutive months
regime_hint: Labor market strengthening with low unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under this signal are negative in 70% of instances (rolling IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST (industrial production) above 2% suggests accelerating business activity, which raises expectations for future profits and yields a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in 50% of months with strong production growth (IC < -0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 105 over three months indicates supply-side weakness, lowering growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (IC > -0.1) during INDPRO contraction periods.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (CPI) rises by more than 0.5% in a month while FEDFUNDS remains below 3%, it signals unexpected inflation pressure without rate hikes, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in 60% of such events (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% after a sustained rise indicates weaker labor market conditions, reducing equity risk premia and producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% after a 3-month rising trend
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (IC < -0.1) during UNRATE cooling episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding 2% signal demand softening, lowering growth forecasts and driving negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change < -2% and RSAFS monthly change < -2% for two months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative in 80% of such contraction episodes (IC > -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE exceeds 6% for three consecutive months in a contraction regime, it reflects weak labor demand and weak consumer spending, producing negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (IC > -0.1) during such episodes.
